convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with 'XMA_Range_Bands' (unknown custom indicator) and includes two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) requiring manual Python reimplementation of the indicator logic and trade management helpers.

other_exits: Long position closed when Close[1] < DnValue[1] (price drops below lower band) if BuyPosClose is true
Short position closed when Close[1] > UpValue[1] (price rises above upper band) if SellPosClose is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative value = fixed lot size (abs value), positive value = deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal requires confirmation: Close[1] must be beyond the band AND Close[0] must have been inside or on the other side of the band (crossover confirmation). Specifically for longs: Close[1] > UpValue[1] AND Close[0] <= UpValue[0]. For shorts: Close[1] < DnValue[1] AND Close[0] >= DnValue[0]. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_, and CIsNewBar helpers. The XMA_Range_Bands indicator uses 9 smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh and must be reimplemented in Python. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar (index 1) with a 2-bar lookback for crossover detection.
python_conversion_notes: Requires full reimplementation of XMA_Range_Bands indicator including 9 smoothing algorithms from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA are non-standard). The channel is computed as: central MA (method1, length1, phase1) +/- Deviation * smoothed_range (method2, length2, phase2). Entry logic uses a 2-bar crossover: current bar close crosses outside the band from inside. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions for position management need replacement with standard Python backtester order logic (open/close with SL/TP). The MM parameter dual behavior (negative=fixed lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be handled.
